images.fullPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / illustration-story.
Asset type: ONE three-frame fixed-scene pixel-art narrative staging concept board, requested 1536x1024, landscape. Not a game-ready sprite sheet.
Input image 1 is the existing N17 outer-ring room. Reframe ONLY its REAR-RIGHT stair arch and the connecting right-side/back outer walkway into a tighter scene, then repeat that same view in three equal left-to-right panels with narrow plain dark gutters. This is an edit-derived storyboard, not a new room.
Preserve the scene topology and materials: original rear-right upward stone stairs in rounded stone arch, dark rectangular stone wall on either side, open footpath below the stairs; crates and barrels remain off to the right outside the walking lane. A small lower-left glimpse of the existing inner railing/pit may anchor the outer ring. Do not redraw the whole room in each panel. Match the source's elevated frontal three-quarter RPG camera; keep identical camera, stair and arch dimensions, seven visible stair treads, wall, floor stones and prop anchors across all three frames. Show the stair upper landing/open threshold clearly rather than a closed door. Restrained low-saturation charcoal stone, dull brown wood/leather, muted slate and desaturated olive. Crisp deliberate hard-edged pixel clusters and restrained color steps, no painting blur, gradients, cinematic bloom or photorealism.
Add exactly TWO replaceable anonymous adult placeholder actors per panel. The willing ordinary guard: small brown-haired adult in plain brown leather over dull gray work clothes, dark boots, no badge, helmet, crown, named NPC likeness or ornate weapon. The player: anonymous adult in plain faded olive cloak, dark trousers, no recognizable original-game protagonist or fixed face. Keep identity/clothes/scale consistent. The player stays stationary at the LEFT SIDE of the stairs' approach, well outside the straight walking lane, relaxed arms by sides; no drawn weapon, pointing command, grabbing or escorting.
Panel 1: the guard is at the foot of the rear-right stairs, having freely approached along the outer walkway, upright and looking up at the open route. The complete clear walking lane is visible beside the player.
Panel 2: SAME guard has walked halfway UP the same stairs, one leg lifted to the next tread, clearly different higher position. The player has not moved toward him, and the lower walkway remains unobstructed.
Panel 3: SAME guard stands at the TOP landing and OPEN EXIT THRESHOLD, beyond the last stair tread but still fully visible, turning his head/shoulder back toward the clear return route. Do not leave him halfway down the staircase. Do not make him disappear to imply escape. The player's relaxed stationary position is unchanged.
Narrative boundary: this depicts a conditional prototype AFTER limited ledger evidence, actual source-cutting tests and opening of a traversable exit have been established in the script. The picture cannot verify those conditions; do not invent an in-frame ritual/test. The guard tests the route voluntarily. One willing guard does not mean everyone defects, all danger ends, crimes are forgiven, Hers is dead/defeated/escaped, or final choice is committed.
Avoid: any third actor, duplicate guard in any one panel, armed coercion, kneeling, surrender, restraints, salute, oath, celebration, amnesty, healing, boss corpse, relocation of stairs, extra doorway, new bridge over pit, safety table, text, labels, arrows, magical route effects, checkmarks, UI, logos, watermarks. Favor clearly readable moving body position and a genuinely empty path.

Edit this three-panel board with ONLY two required corrections. Preserve the established pixel-art style, all wall/floor/railing/crate/barrel anchors, camera, muted palette, frame 1 guard at stair foot, frame 2 guard climbing midway, and the olive-cloaked player's stationary left-side placement in ALL frames. 
Correction 1: the exit at the stair TOP must be the SAME already OPEN dark passage in ALL THREE PANELS. Remove the blocking-looking brick backing at the very top of the stair arch in panels 1 and 2. Give each identical upper arch a dark passage receding behind a flat stone landing. No door appearing/disappearing and no closing wall. No new exit elsewhere.
Correction 2: move ONLY the brown-clothed guard in panel 3 farther UP and AWAY from camera. Both boots must stand on that flat top landing BEYOND the final riser, at the OPEN passage threshold, rather than on an upper stair tread. Keep his whole body visible, proportionately slightly farther away, with head/one shoulder turned back to see the return lane. Place the feet high enough that ALL stair treads remain BELOW his feet. This must unmistakably read as reached threshold rather than still climbing. Keep frame 1 and 2 guard positions unchanged.
Exactly two anonymous adults per panel. The player does not move or threaten. The route from the walkway to the stair foot remains empty apart from this voluntarily moving guard. No surrender, amnesty, labels, UI, new actors or boss. One source-grounded conditional prototype, not a game-state claim.

Precise minimal edit. Change ONLY the brown-clothed guard in the RIGHTMOST panel. He still stands one step below the landing. Move his ENTIRE BODY exactly 50 pixels UPWARD in this 1536x1024 canvas, retaining current height, clothes, turned head, x coordinate and pose. His boots currently end near y180. After the edit both boot soles must end near y130, ON THE FLAT DARK UPPER LANDING, behind the bright top stair lip around y150. His head will be near y20 and remain inside image. Restore vacated upper-stair pixels naturally. Do NOT move the staircase, arch, floor, other actors or camera. Do NOT modify the first or second panel. Keep all three passages open. The third guard must visibly have completed walking up every stair tread and reached the open passage. No new elements or text.

storyGuards: 仅有效N17 defection/D10 systems条件场面，先完成有限账页与实际断源测试、出口开放，绝不画空口全员招降。
守卫自愿试走；玩家不拿武器逼其离开，不添加强制缴械、跪地、束缚、宣誓、拥抱或赦免仪式。
一个人愿离开不代表全部守卫同意；未画的拒战者不默认投降，局部危险仍须由实际状态处理。
赫斯未因此被击败、获赦或保证逃脱；账页留存，不用本镜头改写其死亡/逃脱分支。
这是已有路线的亲自试走行动，不是新路径、新复活、新任务、新兵种、无限援军或新增奖励。
载体待救区、首领活动区与撤离线不得混用；不画人体实验/治愈/已获救患者。
N14 solo不能凭空添加已雇维护班；两名占位人物足够，不用工班维持出口。
N17终局、安全桌确认与冻结保持独立；试走不证明任何政治资格、同意、NE或通关。
N18 X31只允许有限证词，旧犯罪和受害者拒绝原谅均保留。
画面仅表达可见位置变化，仍非实际导航、碰撞、安全、动画注册或运行验证。
